description: Metadata for the optional static HTML report. Report failure does not invalidate measurement artifacts (plan section 17.2). This is a DERIVED, explicitly non-authoritative output (plan section 3.3). It carries an independent format version and must never be read back as measurement evidence.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp. Constrained by pattern, not by 'format': ArchLens supplies no FormatChecker, so a 'format' keyword would be silently unenforced.

output_path.description: Run-relative or user-supplied path. Never an absolute host path inside the rendered document.

title: ArchLens report metadata 1.0
